annotations.title: Start a task under the framework

description: Opens a work record for one legal task and returns the clarifying questions the framework needs answered (step 1, define the task), less any already answered in `answers`. The first two are the country and, in Australia, the state or territory: ask them first. Read the skill ailf://skills/ai-law-framework before the first call.

agent.description: The agent and product doing the work, for example "Claude Code" or "Codex".

answers.description: Answers keyed by question id. `from` is "user" when the user answered when asked, or "request" when the user had already said it (then `quote` holds their words).

actions.description: In this setup, can the agent send, file or change a system by itself (email, a court portal, the document management system)?

quote.description: The user’s own words, when `from` is "request".

ai_restriction.description: Does any court rule, client instruction or firm policy restrict AI use on this matter?

quote.description: The user’s own words, when `from` is "request".

quote.description: The user’s own words, when `from` is "request".
